summary: Underneath it, a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you imagine, feel for others, and create and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
